🖼️ Generative AI

Multimodal AI

In simple words

AI that can work with more than one kind of data, such as text, images and sound, in the same conversation.

AI that understands or creates more than one kind of data, such as text, images, sound or video, and can connect them. By 2025, many chatbots could look at a photo, listen to speech and answer in text or with a voice.

Example. You take a photo of what's in your fridge and ask what you could cook. The AI has to recognise the food in the picture and then write a recipe in words.

Related words

  • Generative AIAI that creates new text, images, music, video or code from patterns it has learned.
  • PromptThe instruction or question you give to a generative AI.
  • Computer visionThe area of AI that helps computers find and recognise things in photos and videos.
